nom: Bubble Super Clear Acne Treating Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results: some say the serum made their face noticeably oilier and worsened breakouts, while one reviewer with oily skin and blemish/hyperpigmentation concerns calls it a favorite.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report the serum helped clear breakouts and healed their skin without over-drying, including one who says it didn't dry out her tween daughter's skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers describing combination skin report visible improvement in forehead acne and pores, though one notes her skin is 'still not glass clear'.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly describe the serum as gentle and non-irritating even with BHA or exfoliating acids, reducing redness and random breakouts, though one reviewer with non-sensitive skin experienced repeated breakouts (contrast noted for reference).
segments.mature: No reviews specifically describe mature skin.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers report faster healing of pimples/spots, some within 2-4 days, and reduced visible blemishes; a minority say the product did nothing for their spots after weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say blackheads, closed comedones and small breakouts cleared within days; a few report no change or worsening blemishes despite consistent use.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers report the serum made their skin oily or greasy, worsening for those already oily; other reviewers do not mention any increase in oil and describe it as lightweight.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness from breakouts and calming effects, including on sensitive skin.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or sensitive skin report the serum did not dry out their skin and provided moisture/soothing; some mention needing to layer moisturizer afterward to avoid dryness.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers note the product is soothing and doesn't burn even when combined with exfoliating acids, though one reviewer confused it with a stronger exfoliating serum that did burn.

aspects.libelle: Pump gets stuck or breaks easily

extraits.texte: I have very sensitive skin and have had irritation issues with numerous BHA products but gave this a shot because of the reviews. This is one of the most gentle BHA serums I have ever used which is suprising considering its 2% BHA. That said, I think 2% bha is too high of a concentration to regularly use on your entire face for most people. I would suggest just using this as a spot treatment. It has a light but emolient texture because of the colloidal oatmeal and layers great under a night cream. I apply it every night just to any visible blemished and they usually are gone by the third day. This is also a great value, I am going on the 3rd month using this as a spot treatment and think this will last 3 more.

WOW! Can we just please talk about the INSTANT results and the ingredients! This formula is so good for my sensitive and dry skin because since my skin is sensitive, it gets random dots easily and redness and this definitely helped! I use this twice a week and it's so awesome!
Works great on my tween daughter's dry, sensitive skin. It doesn't dry her out.

i LOVE super clear from bubble. it has helped heal my dry skin wonderfully. i use it in my skincare routine after my face cleanser then toner. if you're looking for a product to help heal your skin then i suggest using the super clear treatment. i use it every night right before i put on my slam dunk moisturizer. i wake up with my face feeling smooth and glowing. it takes about only a week to notice my skin has healed. highly recommend

extraits.titre: Super clear is my holy grail
extraits.texte: Super clear is a life saver for my acne-prone combination skin. My skin still isn't glass clear but it's improved a lot since using bubble and their products.

My mom got me this as a gift recently, and I was really excited cause I have never tried a bubble product. It helped a little with my acne, but it made my skin really oily. I stopped using it for a bit, and my skin went back to normal. I don't recommend for oily skin.

Used as directed, put on moisturizer after bc the directions said it could make your face dry. My face got soooo oily. Tried it without moisturizer and still oily. Contacted their customer support and was basically told it's my fault bc of my routine.
